note: v3456: The cheap-subset timing gate retries when the total exceeds its ceiling - measure again, keep the lower. That retry sat OUTSIDE the with tick_caches block, so pass 1 measured the PRIMED path production takes and pass 2 the UNPRIMED one it never takes. Measured on a quiet machine, same 94 checks, same minute: primed 5092 ms, unprimed 16791 ms. The unprimed read is about 3x dearer so it is ALWAYS the larger, and min of the two could only ever return pass 1 - the mechanism the block calls what actually decides was inert and could never absolve anything. Proved by AST, and guarded structurally because the branch only runs when the first pass already exceeds the ceiling.
